logistics-operations-manager.title: Logistics Operations Manager
logistics-operations-manager.description: Lead day-to-day logistics operations across the GTA. Own SLA execution, partner network performance, and continuous improvement of dispatch workflows. You'll work closely with dispatch, driver success, and engineering to scale reliable delivery.

senior-software-engineer.title: Senior Software Engineer
senior-software-engineer.description: Build core platform services — dispatch, routing integrations, tracking, and APIs. You'll design systems that handle business-critical shipments with high reliability, observability, and clean abstractions.

platform-engineer.title: Platform Engineer
platform-engineer.description: Own infrastructure, CI/CD, and platform reliability for Porterchain's logistics stack. Improve deployment velocity, monitoring, and security across our cloud environment.

account-executive.title: Account Executive
account-executive.description: Bring Porterchain to growing businesses across Ontario. Run discovery, demos, and pilots with operations leaders who need structured logistics — not ad-hoc couriers.

growth-marketing-manager.title: Growth Marketing Manager
growth-marketing-manager.description: Drive demand for a logistics technology platform. Own content, campaigns, and pipeline programs that speak to operations teams, not consumers.

customer-success-manager.title: Customer Success Manager
customer-success-manager.description: Ensure customers achieve SLA outcomes on Porterchain. Onboard new accounts, monitor health metrics, and partner with operations to resolve exceptions before they escalate.

driver-partner-success-lead.title: Driver Partner Success Lead
driver-partner-success-lead.description: Grow and support Porterchain's driver partner network. Define onboarding, quality standards, and field support so every route runs with predictable workflows and fair compensation.

dispatch-coordinator.title: Dispatch Coordinator
dispatch-coordinator.description: Run live dispatch from Porterchain's command layer. Assign routes, monitor active jobs, manage exceptions, and enforce pre-departure verification on every shipment.
